messages:
mike: Build ready for private/vpc: sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1. Uploaded to staging. Need KMS cosign and deploybot window.

jen: I'm free for the window. Who will sign?

pkg_signer: I can. Confirm manifest tag and KMS alias please.

mike: Tag = sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321. KMS = projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/installer-sign. Short release blurb: on-prem airgap bundle, delta-apply improvement, libtls CVE mitigations.

pkg_signer: ACK. I'll cosign and publish signature to staging path.

deploy-bot: Canary window requested by <@mike>. Canary targets: 3 reserved VPCs. If >=2/3 healthy proceed. Rollback target: v2.13.7.

ops_ryan: I'll monitor metrics. If canary errors >3% for 5m, hold.

sre_aly: Add preflight checksum failures per host as abort metric (>1%). Also watch KV cache behavior.

jen: Support needs sha256 and cosign key id for KB.

maria-support: +1. Put me on thread.

mike: sha256: 3a7f9b2d...f4c1 (full in manifest). cosign key id: projects/release/keys/installer-signer-v3.

pkg_signer: cosign command I'll run:
```
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/release/locations/global/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/installer-sign \
  gcr.io/redwood/sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321
```
I'll upload sig to s3://redwood-staging/airgap/v2.14.0-rc1/signature.json. ETA 18:20 UTC.

deploy-bot: Ensure transport-checksum prehook enabled for private flows (deploybot/hooks/private_transport.yaml).

jen: Note: new delta-apply ordering change. Add rollback flag --legacy-apply and document steps.

maria-support: I'll draft KB with cosign verification and rollback steps.

pkg_signer: Signed and uploaded. SignatureID: sig-20260321-01.

deploy-bot: Window locked at 23:00 UTC. Starting pre-warm 5m prior. Pinning manifest to the tagged digest.

jen: preflight run on canary-2: checksum OK, preflight exit 0, health 200. Minor disk layout warning but not blocking.

ops_ryan: noted. checking /var/lib symlinks.

sre_aly: Observability looks stable; recommend proceed.

mike: Proceed with canary fanout.

deploy-bot: Canary results: canary-1 OK, canary-2 OK, canary-3 initial fail (mirror-2 truncated).

maria-support: Ticket created SUP-5423 for mirror-2 truncated download.

ops_ryan: Replaced mirror-2, re-run canary-3.

canary-3: re-run success, health OK.

deploy-bot: Aggregate canary 3/3 healthy. Proceeding to staged rollout: 10% every 15m, auto-hold on >2% errors.

sre_aly: Watching KV cache regressions during staged rollout.

mike: Release notes: include mirror fallback behavior and quick support checklist.

pkg_signer: Pushing final release notes and rotating signer TTL post-cut.

maria-support: KB published: https://internal.docs/redwood/releases/v2.14.0-rc1 and staging signature path.

deploy-bot: Rollback criteria summary posted: canary unrecoverable within 10m, global error rate >2% sustained 10m, preflight checksum >1% across hosts triggers rollback to v2.13.7.

ops_ryan: I'll keep paged watch.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: success. Artifacts pinned to sealed-installer:v2.14.0-rc1-20260321.
